roads.name: Chemin du Lac Daigle
words: Sweeping and steady: 16 curves in 4.0 miles.
From 160 to 460 ft, with 427 ft of up and down along the way.
roads.ratingNote: A full bar is top marks for that part; the percentages are each part's share of the rating. Curves, length and up and down are ranked against every road in the library. The rest are scored on the road itself: how few side roads join it, whether the curves or the limit set the pace, and how little is built up along it. At the 90 km/h limit its corners still ask for about 1.00 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace. Most of it has no posted limit on the map, so this takes Quebec's 90 km/h.

roads.name: Rue de la Rive
words: Properly twisty: 11 curves in 2.1 miles, about 5 a mile.
Plenty of tight curves among them.
From 16 to 44 ft, with 118 ft of up and down along the way.
Homes line much of it: about 53 buildings a mile beside the road.
